# Panchanga names: source crosswalk (KUN-PAN-M2-NAMES-001)

**Status:** mappings source-checked against IMD; English and Hindi display forms are developer proposals PENDING human Hindi language and Jyotish terminology review. Not customer-facing. Generated by `report/phase1/tools/panchanga_names_crosswalk.py`; do not edit by hand.

Sources (accessed 2026-11-06, Positional Astronomy Centre, India Meteorological Department):

- **IMD-NAMES**: <https://packolkata.imd.gov.in/panchang/ta/tithi-nakshatra> (Names of Tithis, Nakshatras, Yogas, Karanas and Rasis)
- **IMD-EXPLANATION**: <https://packolkata.imd.gov.in/panchang/en/explanation> (Explanation)
- **IMD-DAILY-KARTIKA-1948**: <https://packolkata.imd.gov.in/panchang/bn/kartika> (1948 Saka Era, 2026-2027 A.D.; month Kartika (30 days), 23 October to 21 November 2026)

Columns: index; machine id; IMD spelling as printed (alternates seen on daily pages); proposed English; proposed Hindi; evidence. *Rule* = names page order plus the explanation page rule; *Daily* = the dates on the IMD Kartika 1948 daily pages where that exact slot is printed.
